in_marathi.name: पवन
in_marathi.long_meaning: पवन हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। पवन is a Sanskrit name derived from the word पवन (pavan), which means 'wind' or 'god of wind'. In Hindu mythology, Pavan is one of the eight principal winds and is often depicted as the god of air and wind. He is also considered the god of purification and is believed to bring good health and prosperity.
